"""从冻结v66独立构建双右端候选，生产来源、库与程序保持只读。"""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import subprocess
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PLAN_SHA = "46e074b8cab1b8f02772cb00b737d9c91d49dd7f90ddc14c99d87a913922308b"
BASE_PATH = DATA / "v47-profile-build.py"
HELPER_SHA = "157f157a6de6f6e5cec8935ccd8977e9e13b7f30f674d4e76701bd1c25aed6b5"
assert hashlib.sha256(BASE_PATH.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == HELPER_SHA
BASE = runpy.run_path(str(BASE_PATH))
sha, require, save = (BASE[key] for key in ("sha", "require", "save"))
split_windows, resolve = (BASE[key] for key in ("split_windows", "resolve"))
file_hashes, require_hashes = (BASE[key] for key in ("file_hashes", "require_hashes"))
compile_arguments, execute, dependency_paths = (BASE[key] for key in ("compile_arguments", "execute", "dependency_paths"))


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def helpers():
    return (runpy.run_path(str(DATA / "v83-normal-instrumentation.py")),
            runpy.run_path(str(DATA / "v83-ipm-instrumentation.py")))


def static_check(root=ROOT):
    require(sha(DATA / "v83-plan.json") == PLAN_SHA, "冻结计划变化")
    normal, ipm = helpers()
    checks = {"passed": True, "solver_runs": 0,
              "normal": normal["static_check"](root), "ipm": ipm["static_check"](root)}
    require(checks["normal"]["passed"] is True and checks["ipm"]["passed"] is True,
            "双右端插桩静态检查未通过")
    return checks


def link_arguments(line, build_dir, compiler):
    outer = split_windows(line)
    require(len(outer) == 3 and outer[1].lower() == "/c", "链接包装变化")
    inner = outer[2]
    require(inner.startswith("cd . && ") and inner.endswith(" && cd ."), "链接目录包装变化")
    result = split_windows(inner[len("cd . && "):-len(" && cd .")])
    require(resolve(result[0], build_dir) == compiler, "链接编译器变化")
    return result


def with_override(original, source, obj, frozen, output, override):
    command = compile_arguments(original, source, obj, frozen, ROOT)
    # 覆盖头必须先于所有原项目头；输出目录用于私有头及包含式数学harness。
    command[1:1] = ["-I" + str(override), "-I" + str(output)]
    return command


def collect_dependencies(obj, build_dir, required_header, compiled_inputs):
    paths = dependency_paths(Path(str(obj) + ".d"), build_dir)
    require(required_header.resolve() in {path.resolve() for path in paths}, "实际编译依赖未使用覆盖声明头")
    for path, value in file_hashes(paths).items():
        require(path not in compiled_inputs or compiled_inputs[path] == value, "编译期间依赖变化：" + path)
        compiled_inputs[path] = value
    return paths


def build_math_tests(context):
    output, frozen, override = (context[key] for key in ("output", "frozen", "override"))
    build_dir, environment = context["build_dir"], context["environment"]
    original = context["originals"]["normal_test"]
    source = DATA / "v83-normal-self-test.cpp"
    obj = output / "normal-self.obj"
    command = with_override(original, source, obj, frozen, output, override)
    execute(command, build_dir, output / "normal-self-build.json", environment)
    collect_dependencies(obj, build_dir, context["override_header"], context["compiled_inputs"])
    original_obj = original[original.index("-o") + 1]
    executable = output / "normal-self-test.exe"
    link, replaced = [], {"harness": 0, "normal": 0}
    for value in context["normal_original_link"]:
        if value == original_obj:
            link.append(str(obj)); replaced["harness"] += 1
        elif value == "libsolver_normal_cholesky.a":
            link.append(str(context["objects"]["normal"])); replaced["normal"] += 1
        elif not value.startswith("-Wl,--out-implib,"):
            link.append(value)
    require(replaced == {"harness": 1, "normal": 1}, "Normal数学测试须唯一替换harness和候选实现")
    link[link.index("-o") + 1] = str(executable)
    inputs = file_hashes([resolve(value, build_dir) for value in link if not value.startswith("-") and
                         Path(value).suffix.lower() in (".a", ".lib", ".o", ".obj")])
    context["test_link_inputs"].update(inputs)
    execute(link, build_dir, output / "normal-self-link.json", environment)
    row = execute([str(executable)], ROOT, output / "normal-self-run.json", environment)
    details = json.loads(row["stdout"])
    require(details["passed"] is True and type(details["cases"]) is int and details["cases"] > 0 and
            type(details["pair_cases"]) is int and details["pair_cases"] > 0 and
            details["long_column_interrupted"] is True and isinstance(details["pair_details"], list) and
            len(details["pair_details"]) == details["pair_cases"] and
            all(isinstance(item, str) for item in details["pair_details"]) and
            isinstance(details["snapshots"], list) and len(details["snapshots"]) == details["cases"],
            "Normal完整原方程、pair与预算事务自测失败")
    save(output / "normal-self-check.json", {"passed": True, "lp_runs": 0, "details": details})
    context["test_commands"]["normal"] = {"original_compile": original, "compile": command, "link": link}
    normal_summary = {"passed": True, "cases": details["cases"], "pair_cases": details["pair_cases"],
                      "run_file": "normal-self-run.json", "check_file": "normal-self-check.json"}
    ipm_source = DATA / "v83-ipm-self-test.cpp"
    ipm_obj = output / "ipm-self.obj"
    ipm_command = with_override(context["originals"]["ipm"], ipm_source, ipm_obj, frozen, output, override)
    execute(ipm_command, build_dir, output / "ipm-self-build.json", environment)
    paths = collect_dependencies(ipm_obj, build_dir, context["override_header"], context["compiled_inputs"])
    require({(output / "ipm-pair.cpp").resolve(), (output / "v83-pair-state.hpp").resolve()} <=
            {path.resolve() for path in paths}, "实际KKT数学harness必须包含生成IPM和私有pair状态头")
    main_original = context["originals"]["main"]
    main_obj = main_original[main_original.index("-o") + 1]
    ipm_executable = output / "ipm-self-test.exe"
    ipm_link, replaced = [], {"harness": 0, "ipm": 0, "normal": 0}
    for value in context["original_link"]:
        if value == main_obj:
            ipm_link.append(str(ipm_obj)); replaced["harness"] += 1
        elif value == "libsolver_ipm.a":
            ipm_link.append(str(context["regularized"])); replaced["ipm"] += 1
        elif value == "libsolver_normal_cholesky.a":
            ipm_link.append(str(context["objects"]["normal"])); replaced["normal"] += 1
        elif value != "-municode" and not value.startswith("-Wl,--out-implib,"):
            ipm_link.append(value)
    require(replaced == {"harness": 1, "ipm": 1, "normal": 1} and
            str(context["objects"]["ipm"]) not in ipm_link and "libsolver_ipm.a" not in ipm_link,
            "包含式IPM测试仅链接一次IPM定义，保留原regularized和其他库顺序")
    ipm_link[ipm_link.index("-o") + 1] = str(ipm_executable)
    for path, value in file_hashes([resolve(value, build_dir) for value in ipm_link if not value.startswith("-") and
            Path(value).suffix.lower() in (".a", ".lib", ".o", ".obj")]).items():
        require(path not in context["test_link_inputs"] or context["test_link_inputs"][path] == value,
                "数学测试间显式链接输入变化：" + path)
        context["test_link_inputs"][path] = value
    execute(ipm_link, build_dir, output / "ipm-self-link.json", environment)
    ipm_row = execute([str(ipm_executable)], ROOT, output / "ipm-self-run.json", environment)
    ipm_details = json.loads(ipm_row["stdout"])
    require(ipm_row["stderr"] == "" and ipm_details["passed"] is True and
            type(ipm_details["solver_runs"]) is int and ipm_details["solver_runs"] == 0 and
            all(type(ipm_details[key]) is int and ipm_details[key] > 0 for key in ("cases", "native_cases", "fallback_cases")) and
            all(type(ipm_details[key]) is int and ipm_details[key] == 1 for key in
                ("finish0_refinement_cases", "repair_cases", "budget_cases")),
            "实际KKT双右端、单列精修、标量修复及预算事务数学自测失败")
    save(output / "ipm-self-check.json", {"passed": True, "lp_runs": 0, "details": ipm_details})
    context["test_commands"]["ipm"] = {"original_compile": context["originals"]["ipm"], "compile": ipm_command,
                                       "original_main_compile": main_original, "link": ipm_link}
    return {"normal": normal_summary, "ipm": {**ipm_details, "run_file": "ipm-self-run.json", "check_file": "ipm-self-check.json"}}


def build(output):
    require(output.is_relative_to(ROOT) and not output.exists(), "独立输出须位于工作区且尚不存在")
    plan_path = DATA / "v83-plan.json"
    require(sha(plan_path) == PLAN_SHA, "冻结计划变化")
    plan = read(plan_path)
    identity_path = DATA / "ipm-v66-identity.json"
    identity = read(identity_path)
    baseline_path = DATA / plan["baseline_identity_file"]
    verification_path = DATA / plan["baseline_verification_file"]
    evidence_path = DATA / plan["evidence_file"]
    require(sha(identity_path) == plan["parent_identity_sha256"], "冻结v66身份变化")
    require(sha(baseline_path) == plan["baseline_identity_sha256"] and
            sha(verification_path) == plan["baseline_verification_sha256"] and
            sha(evidence_path) == plan["evidence_sha256"], "起点与前轮证据变化")
    baseline = read(baseline_path)
    require(baseline["files"] == identity["files"] and baseline["libraries"] == identity["libraries"] and
            len(identity["files"]) == 95 and len(identity["libraries"]) == 17, "生产来源与库须保持冻结v66")
    source_archive = DATA / "ipm-v66-source.zip"
    production = ROOT / "build/release/solver.exe"
    parent = ROOT / ".tools/solver-ipm-v66.exe"
    require(sha(source_archive) == identity["source_zip_sha256"] == plan["parent_source_sha256"] and
            sha(production) == sha(parent) == baseline["solver_sha256"] == identity["solver_sha256"] ==
            plan["parent_solver_sha256"], "生产与冻结父程序或源码包变化")
    require(sha(BASE_PATH) == HELPER_SHA, "通用构建辅助器身份变化")
    runner_check = read(DATA / "v83-runner-self-check.json")
    runner_runs = runner_check.get("solver_runs", runner_check.get("lp_runs"))
    require(runner_check.get("passed") is True and type(runner_runs) is int and runner_runs == 0,
            "运行器纯数据自检尚未通过")
    sources = {str(ROOT / name): value for name, value in identity["files"].items()}
    libraries = {str(ROOT / name): value for name, value in identity["libraries"].items()}
    require_hashes(sources); require_hashes(libraries)
    compiler = Path(identity["compiler"])
    require(sha(compiler) == identity["compiler_sha256"], "编译器变化")
    build_dir = ROOT / "build/release"
    ninja = ROOT / ".tools/ninja-1.13.2/ninja.exe"
    command_text = subprocess.check_output([str(ninja), "-C", str(build_dir), "-t", "commands",
                                            "solver.exe", "test_normal_cholesky.exe"], text=True, encoding="utf-8")
    lines = command_text.splitlines()
    originals = {}
    for unit, relative in (("ipm", "src/ipm.cpp"), ("normal", "src/normal_cholesky.cpp"), ("main", "src/main.cpp"),
                           ("normal_test", "tests/test_normal_cholesky.cpp")):
        matches = [split_windows(line) for line in lines if " -c " in line and line.replace("\\", "/").endswith("/" + relative)]
        require(len(matches) == 1 and resolve(matches[0][0], build_dir) == compiler, "原编译模板不唯一：" + unit)
        originals[unit] = matches[0]
    solver_links = [line for line in lines if " -o solver.exe " in line]
    require(solver_links == [identity["link_command"]], "生产链接序列变化")
    original_link = link_arguments(solver_links[0], build_dir, compiler)
    normal_links = [line for line in lines if " -o test_normal_cholesky.exe " in line]
    require(len(normal_links) == 1, "Normal数学harness链接模板不唯一")
    normal_original_link = link_arguments(normal_links[0], build_dir, compiler)
    explicit = [resolve(value, build_dir) for value in original_link + normal_original_link if not value.startswith("-") and
                Path(value).suffix.lower() in (".a", ".lib")]
    explicit.extend(resolve(value, build_dir) for value in original_link if not value.startswith("-") and
                    Path(value).suffix.lower() in (".o", ".obj"))
    regularized = build_dir / "CMakeFiles/solver_ipm.dir/src/regularized_ldl.cpp.obj"
    helper_files = [DATA / name for name in ("v83-normal-instrumentation.py", "v83-ipm-instrumentation.py",
                                            "v83-normal-self-test.cpp", "v83-ipm-self-test.cpp", "v83-run.py",
                                            "v83-runner-self-check.json", "v66-run.py")]
    protected = file_hashes([production, parent, compiler, ninja, identity_path, source_archive,
                            baseline_path, verification_path, evidence_path, plan_path, BASE_PATH, Path(__file__),
                            build_dir / "build.ninja", build_dir / "CMakeFiles/rules.ninja", regularized,
                            *explicit, *helper_files])
    normal_helper, ipm_helper = helpers()
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    frozen = output / "frozen"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(source_archive) as archive:
        require(len(archive.namelist()) == 95 and set(archive.namelist()) == set(identity["files"]), "冻结来源包成员变化")
        require(all((frozen / name).resolve().is_relative_to(frozen.resolve()) for name in archive.namelist()), "冻结来源包路径越界")
        archive.extractall(frozen)
    frozen_files = {str(frozen / name): value for name, value in identity["files"].items()}
    require_hashes(frozen_files)
    save(output / "static-check.json", static_check(frozen))
    (output / "ninja-commands.txt").write_text(command_text, encoding="utf-8")
    override = output / "override/include"
    override_header = override / "solver/detail/normal_cholesky.hpp"
    override_header.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    transforms, generated = {}, {}
    for unit, source, destination, helper, arguments in (
        ("ipm", frozen / "src/ipm.cpp", output / "ipm-pair.cpp", ipm_helper, ()),
        ("normal", frozen / "src/normal_cholesky.cpp", output / "normal-pair.cpp", normal_helper, ("normal",)),
        ("normal_header", frozen / "include/solver/detail/normal_cholesky.hpp", override_header, normal_helper, ("normal_header",))):
        patched, changes = helper["transform"](source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), *arguments)
        destination.write_text(patched, encoding="utf-8")
        generated.update(file_hashes([destination]))
        transforms[unit] = {"source": str(source), "source_sha256": sha(source), "patched": str(destination),
                            "patched_sha256": sha(destination), "changes": changes}
    private_header = output / "v83-pair-state.hpp"
    private_header.write_text(ipm_helper["HEADER"], encoding="utf-8")
    generated.update(file_hashes([private_header]))
    save(output / "transforms.json", transforms)
    objects, commands, compiled_inputs = {}, {}, {}
    environment = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.upper().startswith("SOLVER_V") and key.upper() != "OPENBLAS_CORETYPE"}
    environment.update(dict.fromkeys(("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS"), "1"))
    environment["PATH"] = str(compiler.parent) + os.pathsep + environment.get("PATH", "")
    for unit in ("ipm", "normal"):
        obj = output / (unit + "-pair.obj")
        objects[unit] = obj
        commands[unit] = with_override(originals[unit], output / (unit + "-pair.cpp"), obj, frozen, output, override)
        execute(commands[unit], build_dir, output / (unit + "-compile.json"), environment)
        paths = collect_dependencies(obj, build_dir, override_header, compiled_inputs)
        if unit == "ipm": require(private_header.resolve() in {path.resolve() for path in paths}, "IPM实际依赖必须包含私有pair状态头")
    link, replaced = [], {"ipm": 0, "normal": 0}
    for value in original_link:
        if value == "libsolver_ipm.a":
            link.extend([str(objects["ipm"]), str(regularized)]); replaced["ipm"] += 1
        elif value == "libsolver_normal_cholesky.a":
            link.append(str(objects["normal"])); replaced["normal"] += 1
        elif not value.startswith("-Wl,--out-implib,"):
            link.append(value)
    require(replaced == {"ipm": 1, "normal": 1}, "候选只能唯一替换两份库")
    executable = output / "solver-pair.exe"
    link[link.index("-o") + 1] = str(executable)
    link_inputs = file_hashes([resolve(value, build_dir) for value in link if not value.startswith("-") and
                              Path(value).suffix.lower() in (".a", ".lib", ".o", ".obj")])
    execute(link, build_dir, output / "link.json", environment)
    context = dict(output=output, frozen=frozen, override=override, override_header=override_header,
                   compiler=compiler, build_dir=build_dir, originals=originals, original_link=original_link,
                   normal_original_link=normal_original_link, regularized=regularized, objects=objects,
                   environment=environment, compiled_inputs=compiled_inputs, protected=protected, generated=generated,
                   test_link_inputs={}, test_commands={})
    tests = build_math_tests(context)
    for values in (protected, sources, libraries, frozen_files, generated, compiled_inputs, link_inputs,
                   context["test_link_inputs"]): require_hashes(values)
    outputs = file_hashes([path for path in output.rglob("*") if path.is_file() and not path.is_relative_to(frozen)])
    manifest = {"created_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), "production_changes": False,
        "experimental_candidate_only": True, "plan_sha256": PLAN_SHA,
        "production_executable": str(production), "production_sha256": sha(production),
        "frozen_parent_executable": str(parent), "frozen_parent_sha256": sha(parent),
        "executable": str(executable), "executable_sha256": sha(executable),
        "baseline_identity_file": str(baseline_path), "baseline_identity_sha256": sha(baseline_path),
        "baseline_verification_file": str(verification_path), "baseline_verification_sha256": sha(verification_path),
        "frozen_files": identity["files"], "current_files": baseline["files"], "actual_libraries": baseline["libraries"],
        "override_include_directory": str(override), "override_header": str(override_header),
        "private_pair_header": str(private_header), "override_header_used_by_all_compiled_units": True,
        "protected_before_and_after": protected, "generated_inputs_before_and_after": generated,
        "compile_inputs_after_and_final": compiled_inputs, "link_explicit_before_and_after": link_inputs,
        "test_link_explicit_before_and_after": context["test_link_inputs"],
        "outputs": outputs, "math_self_tests": tests,
        "commands": {"cwd": str(build_dir), "original_compile": {unit: originals[unit] for unit in ("ipm", "normal")},
                     "original_link": original_link, "normal_original_link": normal_original_link,
                     "compile": commands, "link": link, "math_self_tests": context["test_commands"]},
        "implicit_link_inputs_verified": False, "lp_runs": 0}
    save(output / "build-manifest.json", manifest)
    print(json.dumps({"passed": True, "compiled_units": ["ipm", "normal"], "solver_sha256": manifest["executable_sha256"],
                      "math_self_tests": tests, "lp_runs": 0}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=ROOT / ".tools/v83-pair")
    parser.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true", help="仅锁计划和插桩静态边界，不编译或运行LP")
    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    if arguments.self_test:
        print(json.dumps(static_check(), ensure_ascii=False))
    else:
        build(arguments.output.resolve())

"""从冻结v66独立构建双右端候选，生产来源、库与程序保持只读。"""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import subprocess
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PLAN_SHA = "46e074b8cab1b8f02772cb00b737d9c91d49dd7f90ddc14c99d87a913922308b"
BASE_PATH = DATA / "v47-profile-build.py"
HELPER_SHA = "157f157a6de6f6e5cec8935ccd8977e9e13b7f30f674d4e76701bd1c25aed6b5"
assert hashlib.sha256(BASE_PATH.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == HELPER_SHA
BASE = runpy.run_path(str(BASE_PATH))
sha, require, save = (BASE[key] for key in ("sha", "require", "save"))
split_windows, resolve = (BASE[key] for key in ("split_windows", "resolve"))
file_hashes, require_hashes = (BASE[key] for key in ("file_hashes", "require_hashes"))
compile_arguments, execute, dependency_paths = (BASE[key] for key in ("compile_arguments", "execute", "dependency_paths"))


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def helpers():
    return (runpy.run_path(str(DATA / "v83-normal-instrumentation.py")),
            runpy.run_path(str(DATA / "v83-ipm-instrumentation.py")))


def static_check(root=ROOT):
    require(sha(DATA / "v83-plan.json") == PLAN_SHA, "冻结计划变化")
    normal, ipm = helpers()
    checks = {"passed": True, "solver_runs": 0,
              "normal": normal["static_check"](root), "ipm": ipm["static_check"](root)}
    require(checks["normal"]["passed"] is True and checks["ipm"]["passed"] is True,
            "双右端插桩静态检查未通过")
    return checks


def link_arguments(line, build_dir, compiler):
    outer = split_windows(line)
    require(len(outer) == 3 and outer[1].lower() == "/c", "链接包装变化")
    inner = outer[2]
    require(inner.startswith("cd . && ") and inner.endswith(" && cd ."), "链接目录包装变化")
    result = split_windows(inner[len("cd . && "):-len(" && cd .")])
    require(resolve(result[0], build_dir) == compiler, "链接编译器变化")
    return result


def with_override(original, source, obj, frozen, output, override):
    command = compile_arguments(original, source, obj, frozen, ROOT)
    # 覆盖头必须先于所有原项目头；输出目录用于私有头及包含式数学harness。
    command[1:1] = ["-I" + str(override), "-I" + str(output)]
    return command


def collect_dependencies(obj, build_dir, required_header, compiled_inputs):
    paths = dependency_paths(Path(str(obj) + ".d"), build_dir)
    require(required_header.resolve() in {path.resolve() for path in paths}, "实际编译依赖未使用覆盖声明头")
    for path, value in file_hashes(paths).items():
        require(path not in compiled_inputs or compiled_inputs[path] == value, "编译期间依赖变化：" + path)
        compiled_inputs[path] = value
    return paths


def build_math_tests(context):
    output, frozen, override = (context[key] for key in ("output", "frozen", "override"))
    build_dir, environment = context["build_dir"], context["environment"]
    original = context["originals"]["normal_test"]
    source = DATA / "v83-normal-self-test.cpp"
    obj = output / "normal-self.obj"
    command = with_override(original, source, obj, frozen, output, override)
    execute(command, build_dir, output / "normal-self-build.json", environment)
    collect_dependencies(obj, build_dir, context["override_header"], context["compiled_inputs"])
    original_obj = original[original.index("-o") + 1]
    executable = output / "normal-self-test.exe"
    link, replaced = [], {"harness": 0, "normal": 0}
    for value in context["normal_original_link"]:
        if value == original_obj:
            link.append(str(obj)); replaced["harness"] += 1
        elif value == "libsolver_normal_cholesky.a":
            link.append(str(context["objects"]["normal"])); replaced["normal"] += 1
        elif not value.startswith("-Wl,--out-implib,"):
            link.append(value)
    require(replaced == {"harness": 1, "normal": 1}, "Normal数学测试须唯一替换harness和候选实现")
    link[link.index("-o") + 1] = str(executable)
    inputs = file_hashes([resolve(value, build_dir) for value in link if not value.startswith("-") and
                         Path(value).suffix.lower() in (".a", ".lib", ".o", ".obj")])
    context["test_link_inputs"].update(inputs)
    execute(link, build_dir, output / "normal-self-link.json", environment)
    row = execute([str(executable)], ROOT, output / "normal-self-run.json", environment)
    details = json.loads(row["stdout"])
    require(details["passed"] is True and type(details["cases"]) is int and details["cases"] > 0 and
            type(details["pair_cases"]) is int and details["pair_cases"] > 0 and
            details["long_column_interrupted"] is True and isinstance(details["pair_details"], list) and
            len(details["pair_details"]) == details["pair_cases"] and
            all(isinstance(item, str) for item in details["pair_details"]) and
            isinstance(details["snapshots"], list) and len(details["snapshots"]) == details["cases"],
            "Normal完整原方程、pair与预算事务自测失败")
    save(output / "normal-self-check.json", {"passed": True, "lp_runs": 0, "details": details})
    context["test_commands"]["normal"] = {"original_compile": original, "compile": command, "link": link}
    normal_summary = {"passed": True, "cases": details["cases"], "pair_cases": details["pair_cases"],
                      "run_file": "normal-self-run.json", "check_file": "normal-self-check.json"}
    ipm_source = DATA / "v83-ipm-self-test.cpp"
    ipm_obj = output / "ipm-self.obj"
    ipm_command = with_override(context["originals"]["ipm"], ipm_source, ipm_obj, frozen, output, override)
    execute(ipm_command, build_dir, output / "ipm-self-build.json", environment)
    paths = collect_dependencies(ipm_obj, build_dir, context["override_header"], context["compiled_inputs"])
    require({(output / "ipm-pair.cpp").resolve(), (output / "v83-pair-state.hpp").resolve()} <=
            {path.resolve() for path in paths}, "实际KKT数学harness必须包含生成IPM和私有pair状态头")
    main_original = context["originals"]["main"]
    main_obj = main_original[main_original.index("-o") + 1]
    ipm_executable = output / "ipm-self-test.exe"
    ipm_link, replaced = [], {"harness": 0, "ipm": 0, "normal": 0}
    for value in context["original_link"]:
        if value == main_obj:
            ipm_link.append(str(ipm_obj)); replaced["harness"] += 1
        elif value == "libsolver_ipm.a":
            ipm_link.append(str(context["regularized"])); replaced["ipm"] += 1
        elif value == "libsolver_normal_cholesky.a":
            ipm_link.append(str(context["objects"]["normal"])); replaced["normal"] += 1
        elif value != "-municode" and not value.startswith("-Wl,--out-implib,"):
            ipm_link.append(value)
    require(replaced == {"harness": 1, "ipm": 1, "normal": 1} and
            str(context["objects"]["ipm"]) not in ipm_link and "libsolver_ipm.a" not in ipm_link,
            "包含式IPM测试仅链接一次IPM定义，保留原regularized和其他库顺序")
    ipm_link[ipm_link.index("-o") + 1] = str(ipm_executable)
    for path, value in file_hashes([resolve(value, build_dir) for value in ipm_link if not value.startswith("-") and
            Path(value).suffix.lower() in (".a", ".lib", ".o", ".obj")]).items():
        require(path not in context["test_link_inputs"] or context["test_link_inputs"][path] == value,
                "数学测试间显式链接输入变化：" + path)
        context["test_link_inputs"][path] = value
    execute(ipm_link, build_dir, output / "ipm-self-link.json", environment)
    ipm_row = execute([str(ipm_executable)], ROOT, output / "ipm-self-run.json", environment)
    ipm_details = json.loads(ipm_row["stdout"])
    require(ipm_row["stderr"] == "" and ipm_details["passed"] is True and
            type(ipm_details["solver_runs"]) is int and ipm_details["solver_runs"] == 0 and
            all(type(ipm_details[key]) is int and ipm_details[key] > 0 for key in ("cases", "native_cases", "fallback_cases")) and
            all(type(ipm_details[key]) is int and ipm_details[key] == 1 for key in
                ("finish0_refinement_cases", "repair_cases", "budget_cases")),
            "实际KKT双右端、单列精修、标量修复及预算事务数学自测失败")
    save(output / "ipm-self-check.json", {"passed": True, "lp_runs": 0, "details": ipm_details})
    context["test_commands"]["ipm"] = {"original_compile": context["originals"]["ipm"], "compile": ipm_command,
                                       "original_main_compile": main_original, "link": ipm_link}
    return {"normal": normal_summary, "ipm": {**ipm_details, "run_file": "ipm-self-run.json", "check_file": "ipm-self-check.json"}}


def build(output):
    require(output.is_relative_to(ROOT) and not output.exists(), "独立输出须位于工作区且尚不存在")
    plan_path = DATA / "v83-plan.json"
    require(sha(plan_path) == PLAN_SHA, "冻结计划变化")
    plan = read(plan_path)
    identity_path = DATA / "ipm-v66-identity.json"
    identity = read(identity_path)
    baseline_path = DATA / plan["baseline_identity_file"]
    verification_path = DATA / plan["baseline_verification_file"]
    evidence_path = DATA / plan["evidence_file"]
    require(sha(identity_path) == plan["parent_identity_sha256"], "冻结v66身份变化")
    require(sha(baseline_path) == plan["baseline_identity_sha256"] and
            sha(verification_path) == plan["baseline_verification_sha256"] and
            sha(evidence_path) == plan["evidence_sha256"], "起点与前轮证据变化")
    baseline = read(baseline_path)
    require(baseline["files"] == identity["files"] and baseline["libraries"] == identity["libraries"] and
            len(identity["files"]) == 95 and len(identity["libraries"]) == 17, "生产来源与库须保持冻结v66")
    source_archive = DATA / "ipm-v66-source.zip"
    production = ROOT / "build/release/solver.exe"
    parent = ROOT / ".tools/solver-ipm-v66.exe"
    require(sha(source_archive) == identity["source_zip_sha256"] == plan["parent_source_sha256"] and
            sha(production) == sha(parent) == baseline["solver_sha256"] == identity["solver_sha256"] ==
            plan["parent_solver_sha256"], "生产与冻结父程序或源码包变化")
    require(sha(BASE_PATH) == HELPER_SHA, "通用构建辅助器身份变化")
    runner_check = read(DATA / "v83-runner-self-check.json")
    runner_runs = runner_check.get("solver_runs", runner_check.get("lp_runs"))
    require(runner_check.get("passed") is True and type(runner_runs) is int and runner_runs == 0,
            "运行器纯数据自检尚未通过")
    sources = {str(ROOT / name): value for name, value in identity["files"].items()}
    libraries = {str(ROOT / name): value for name, value in identity["libraries"].items()}
    require_hashes(sources); require_hashes(libraries)
    compiler = Path(identity["compiler"])
    require(sha(compiler) == identity["compiler_sha256"], "编译器变化")
    build_dir = ROOT / "build/release"
    ninja = ROOT / ".tools/ninja-1.13.2/ninja.exe"
    command_text = subprocess.check_output([str(ninja), "-C", str(build_dir), "-t", "commands",
                                            "solver.exe", "test_normal_cholesky.exe"], text=True, encoding="utf-8")
    lines = command_text.splitlines()
    originals = {}
    for unit, relative in (("ipm", "src/ipm.cpp"), ("normal", "src/normal_cholesky.cpp"), ("main", "src/main.cpp"),
                           ("normal_test", "tests/test_normal_cholesky.cpp")):
        matches = [split_windows(line) for line in lines if " -c " in line and line.replace("\\", "/").endswith("/" + relative)]
        require(len(matches) == 1 and resolve(matches[0][0], build_dir) == compiler, "原编译模板不唯一：" + unit)
        originals[unit] = matches[0]
    solver_links = [line for line in lines if " -o solver.exe " in line]
    require(solver_links == [identity["link_command"]], "生产链接序列变化")
    original_link = link_arguments(solver_links[0], build_dir, compiler)
    normal_links = [line for line in lines if " -o test_normal_cholesky.exe " in line]
    require(len(normal_links) == 1, "Normal数学harness链接模板不唯一")
    normal_original_link = link_arguments(normal_links[0], build_dir, compiler)
    explicit = [resolve(value, build_dir) for value in original_link + normal_original_link if not value.startswith("-") and
                Path(value).suffix.lower() in (".a", ".lib")]
    explicit.extend(resolve(value, build_dir) for value in original_link if not value.startswith("-") and
                    Path(value).suffix.lower() in (".o", ".obj"))
    regularized = build_dir / "CMakeFiles/solver_ipm.dir/src/regularized_ldl.cpp.obj"
    helper_files = [DATA / name for name in ("v83-normal-instrumentation.py", "v83-ipm-instrumentation.py",
                                            "v83-normal-self-test.cpp", "v83-ipm-self-test.cpp", "v83-run.py",
                                            "v83-runner-self-check.json", "v66-run.py")]
    protected = file_hashes([production, parent, compiler, ninja, identity_path, source_archive,
                            baseline_path, verification_path, evidence_path, plan_path, BASE_PATH, Path(__file__),
                            build_dir / "build.ninja", build_dir / "CMakeFiles/rules.ninja", regularized,
                            *explicit, *helper_files])
    normal_helper, ipm_helper = helpers()
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    frozen = output / "frozen"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(source_archive) as archive:
        require(len(archive.namelist()) == 95 and set(archive.namelist()) == set(identity["files"]), "冻结来源包成员变化")
        require(all((frozen / name).resolve().is_relative_to(frozen.resolve()) for name in archive.namelist()), "冻结来源包路径越界")
        archive.extractall(frozen)
    frozen_files = {str(frozen / name): value for name, value in identity["files"].items()}
    require_hashes(frozen_files)
    save(output / "static-check.json", static_check(frozen))
    (output / "ninja-commands.txt").write_text(command_text, encoding="utf-8")
    override = output / "override/include"
    override_header = override / "solver/detail/normal_cholesky.hpp"
    override_header.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    transforms, generated = {}, {}
    for unit, source, destination, helper, arguments in (
        ("ipm", frozen / "src/ipm.cpp", output / "ipm-pair.cpp", ipm_helper, ()),
        ("normal", frozen / "src/normal_cholesky.cpp", output / "normal-pair.cpp", normal_helper, ("normal",)),
        ("normal_header", frozen / "include/solver/detail/normal_cholesky.hpp", override_header, normal_helper, ("normal_header",))):
        patched, changes = helper["transform"](source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), *arguments)
        destination.write_text(patched, encoding="utf-8")
        generated.update(file_hashes([destination]))
        transforms[unit] = {"source": str(source), "source_sha256": sha(source), "patched": str(destination),
                            "patched_sha256": sha(destination), "changes": changes}
    private_header = output / "v83-pair-state.hpp"
    private_header.write_text(ipm_helper["HEADER"], encoding="utf-8")
    generated.update(file_hashes([private_header]))
    save(output / "transforms.json", transforms)
    objects, commands, compiled_inputs = {}, {}, {}
    environment = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.upper().startswith("SOLVER_V") and key.upper() != "OPENBLAS_CORETYPE"}
    environment.update(dict.fromkeys(("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS"), "1"))
    environment["PATH"] = str(compiler.parent) + os.pathsep + environment.get("PATH", "")
    for unit in ("ipm", "normal"):
        obj = output / (unit + "-pair.obj")
        objects[unit] = obj
        commands[unit] = with_override(originals[unit], output / (unit + "-pair.cpp"), obj, frozen, output, override)
        execute(commands[unit], build_dir, output / (unit + "-compile.json"), environment)
        paths = collect_dependencies(obj, build_dir, override_header, compiled_inputs)
        if unit == "ipm": require(private_header.resolve() in {path.resolve() for path in paths}, "IPM实际依赖必须包含私有pair状态头")
    link, replaced = [], {"ipm": 0, "normal": 0}
    for value in original_link:
        if value == "libsolver_ipm.a":
            link.extend([str(objects["ipm"]), str(regularized)]); replaced["ipm"] += 1
        elif value == "libsolver_normal_cholesky.a":
            link.append(str(objects["normal"])); replaced["normal"] += 1
        elif not value.startswith("-Wl,--out-implib,"):
            link.append(value)
    require(replaced == {"ipm": 1, "normal": 1}, "候选只能唯一替换两份库")
    executable = output / "solver-pair.exe"
    link[link.index("-o") + 1] = str(executable)
    link_inputs = file_hashes([resolve(value, build_dir) for value in link if not value.startswith("-") and
                              Path(value).suffix.lower() in (".a", ".lib", ".o", ".obj")])
    execute(link, build_dir, output / "link.json", environment)
    context = dict(output=output, frozen=frozen, override=override, override_header=override_header,
                   compiler=compiler, build_dir=build_dir, originals=originals, original_link=original_link,
                   normal_original_link=normal_original_link, regularized=regularized, objects=objects,
                   environment=environment, compiled_inputs=compiled_inputs, protected=protected, generated=generated,
                   test_link_inputs={}, test_commands={})
    tests = build_math_tests(context)
    for values in (protected, sources, libraries, frozen_files, generated, compiled_inputs, link_inputs,
                   context["test_link_inputs"]): require_hashes(values)
    outputs = file_hashes([path for path in output.rglob("*") if path.is_file() and not path.is_relative_to(frozen)])
    manifest = {"created_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), "production_changes": False,
        "experimental_candidate_only": True, "plan_sha256": PLAN_SHA,
        "production_executable": str(production), "production_sha256": sha(production),
        "frozen_parent_executable": str(parent), "frozen_parent_sha256": sha(parent),
        "executable": str(executable), "executable_sha256": sha(executable),
        "baseline_identity_file": str(baseline_path), "baseline_identity_sha256": sha(baseline_path),
        "baseline_verification_file": str(verification_path), "baseline_verification_sha256": sha(verification_path),

def sha(path):

def save(path, value):

def save_once(path, value):

        assert read(path) == value, "禁止覆盖不一致证据"

assert sha(DATA / "v66-run.py") == HELPER_SHA

def fixed_plan():

def specification(stage, plan):

def variants(stage):

def options_for(stage, variant, executable, plan):
    backend = "highs" if variant == "highs" else "ipm"

        wall_timeout=plan["wall_timeout"], threads=plan["threads"], mip_gap=0.0001,

    else:

def valid_command(row, variant, plan):
    args = row["command"]
    if len(args[3:]) % 2:
        return False
    flags = dict(zip(args[3::2], args[4::2]))
    if len(flags) * 2 != len(args[3:]):
        return False
    backend = "highs" if variant == "highs" else "ipm"
    expected = {"--backend": backend, "--time-limit": "5.0", "--threads": "1", "--seed": "0", "--mip-gap": "0.0001"}
    if backend == "ipm":
        expected.update({"--iteration-limit": "200", "--scaling-passes": "5", "--ipm-method": "homogeneous",
            "--ipm-linear-accuracy": "homogeneous_repair", "--ipm-linear-solver": "normal_cholmod_aat",
            "--ipm-direction-retries": "0", "--ipm-objective-scaling": "off"})
        expected.update({"--ipm-" + key: value for key, value in plan["shared_ipm"].items()})
    else:
        expected.update({"--highs-" + key: value for key, value in plan["highs_reference"].items()})
    return flags == expected


@contextlib.contextmanager
def solver_environment(enabled):
    """单进程串行作用域：每次调用重建环境，结束后逐字恢复。"""
    prior = dict(os.environ)
    clean = {key: value for key, value in prior.items() if not key.upper().startswith("SOLVER_V") and key.upper() != "OPENBLAS_CORETYPE"}
    clean.update({key: "1" for key in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS")})
    if enabled:
        clean["SOLVER_V83_PAIR_RHS"] = "1"
    try:
        os.environ.clear()
        os.environ.update(clean)
        yield
    finally:
        os.environ.clear()
        os.environ.update(prior)


def inspect_marker(stderr, variant):
    lines = [line for line in stderr.splitlines() if line.startswith(MARKER)]
    if variant in ("frozen_v66", "highs"):
        return (None, None) if not lines else (None, "unexpected_marker")
    if len(lines) != 1:
        return None, "marker_count"
    try:
        value = benchmark.strict_json(lines[0][len(MARKER):])
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None, "invalid_marker_json"
    if not valid_marker(value, variant == "diagnostic_on"):
        return value, "invalid_marker_schema"
    return value, None


def valid_marker(value, enabled):
    fields = {"schema", "enabled", *MARKER_COUNTS}
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != fields or type(value["schema"]) is not int or value["schema"] != 1:
        return False
    if type(value["enabled"]) is not bool or value["enabled"] is not enabled:
        return False
    if any(type(value[key]) is not int or not 0 <= value[key] <= 200 for key in MARKER_COUNTS):
        return False
    if not enabled:
        return all(value[key] == 0 for key in MARKER_COUNTS)
    order = ("pairs_started", "normal_calls_started", "normal_calls_completed", "finish0_started",
        "finish0_completed", "finish1_started", "finish1_completed", "pairs_completed")
    if any(value[left] < value[right] for left, right in zip(order, order[1:])):
        return False
    return value["pairs_started"] - value["pairs_completed"] <= 1 and \
        value["finish0_completed"] == value["finish1_started"] and \
        value["finish1_completed"] == value["pairs_completed"]


def valid_process(row):
    if row.get("pair_marker_error") is not None or row.get("configuration_matches") is not True:
        return False
    if not base.valid_process(row):
        return False
    report = row["report"]
    return report["backend"] != "ipm" or benchmark.valid_homogeneous_work(report) and benchmark.valid_homogeneous_scaled_work(report) and benchmark.valid_homogeneous_repair_work(report)


def configuration_matches(report, stage, variant, model, plan):
    side = "reference" if variant == variants(stage)[0] else "candidate"
    backend = "highs" if variant == "highs" else "ipm"
    return isinstance(report, dict) and report.get("input") == model["input"] and report.get("backend") == backend \
        and report.get("backend_version") == ("1.15.1" if backend == "highs" else "ipm-cpu-0.53.0") \
        and base.typed_equal(report.get("options"), base.expected_options(stage, side, plan))


def pair_result(a, b, plan):
    answer = base.pair_result(a, b, plan)
    if not valid_process(a) or not valid_process(b):
        answer.update(valid_processes=False, category="invalid_process")
    return answer


def quality_fields(row, model, expected_solver, plan):
    numerical = compare_lp.numerical_seconds(row)
    failure = compare_lp.quality_failure(row, model, row["model_sha256_after"], expected_solver,
        row["solver_sha256_after"] if row["solver_sha256_before"] == row["solver_sha256_after"] else None)
    wall_exceeded = row["elapsed_wall_seconds"] > plan["wall_timeout"]
    numerical_exceeded = numerical > plan["time_limit"] if benchmark.finite_real(numerical) else None
    probe = dict(row, numerical_seconds=numerical)
    if not valid_process(probe):
        failure = "invalid_process"
    elif failure is None and wall_exceeded:
        failure = "wall_budget_exceeded"
    elif failure is None and numerical_exceeded:
        failure = "numerical_budget_exceeded"
    return dict(numerical_seconds=numerical, numerical_budget_exceeded=numerical_exceeded,
        wall_budget_exceeded=wall_exceeded, quality_failure=failure, quality_pass=failure is None,
        quality_penalized_wall_seconds=min(row["elapsed_wall_seconds"], plan["wall_timeout"]) if failure is None else plan["wall_timeout"],
        quality_penalized_numerical_seconds=min(numerical, plan["time_limit"]) if failure is None else plan["time_limit"])


def valid_math_evidence(role, checks, raw, work):
    if role not in ("normal", "ipm") or not isinstance(checks, dict) or checks.get("passed") is not True or \
        type(checks.get("lp_runs")) is not int or checks["lp_runs"] != 0 or not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return False
    if type(raw.get("returncode")) is not int or raw["returncode"] != 0 or raw.get("wall_timeout") is not False \
        or raw.get("command") != [str(work / (role + "-self-test.exe"))] or raw.get("cwd") != str(ROOT):
        return False
    if not isinstance(raw.get("stdout"), str) or not isinstance(raw.get("stderr"), str):
        return False
    try:
        value = benchmark.strict_json(raw["stdout"])
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return False
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get("passed") is not True or not base.typed_equal(value, checks.get("details")):
        return False
    if type(value.get("cases")) is not int or value["cases"] <= 0:
        return False
    if role == "normal":
        return type(value.get("pair_cases")) is int and value["pair_cases"] > 0 and \
            isinstance(value.get("pair_details"), list) and len(value["pair_details"]) == value["pair_cases"] and \
            all(isinstance(label, str) and label for label in value["pair_details"]) and \
            value.get("long_column_interrupted") is True and isinstance(value.get("snapshots"), list) and \
            len(value["snapshots"]) == value["cases"]
    return raw["stderr"] == "" and type(value.get("solver_runs")) is int and value["solver_runs"] == 0 and \
        all(type(value.get(key)) is int and value[key] > 0 for key in ("native_cases", "fallback_cases")) and \
        all(type(value.get(key)) is int and value[key] == 1 for key in

        "reference": str(PARENT), "reference_sha256": plan["parent_solver_sha256"], "protected": protected}

def archive(stage):
    plan = fixed_plan()
    expected = specification(stage, plan)
    manifest = read(DATA / f"v83-{stage}-manifest.json")
    summary = read(DATA / f"v83-{stage}-summary.json")
    raw = DATA / f"v83-{stage}-runs.jsonl.gz"
    rows = [benchmark.strict_json(line) for line in gzip.decompress(raw.read_bytes()).splitlines()]
    identity = read(DATA / "v83-run-identity.json")
    assert manifest["identity_sha256"] == sha(DATA / "v83-run-identity.json")
    assert manifest["plan_sha256"] == PLAN_SHA and manifest["models"] == expected["models"]
    assert manifest["models_file_sha256"] == expected["models_file_sha256"]
    assert manifest["stage"] == stage and manifest["repeats"] == expected["repeats"]
    assert manifest["variants"] == list(variants(stage))
    for field in ("time_limit", "wall_timeout", "threads", "seed"):
        assert manifest[field] == plan[field]
    scheduled = list(compare_lp.schedule(expected["models"], expected["repeats"], variants(stage)))
    assert len(rows) == len(scheduled)
    for index, (row, (model, repeat, position, variant)) in enumerate(zip(rows, scheduled)):
        executable = Path(identity["candidate"] if variant.startswith("diagnostic_") else identity["reference"])
        digest = identity["candidate_sha256"] if variant.startswith("diagnostic_") else identity["reference_sha256"]
        assert (row["run_index"], row["model_index"], row["repetition"], row["position_in_pair"], row["requested_variant"]) == (index, model["model_index"], repeat, position, variant)
        assert row["input"] == model["input"] and row["seed"] == plan["seed"]
        assert row["command"][:3] == [str(executable), "solve", model["input"]]
        assert valid_command(row, variant, plan)
        assert row["pair_environment"] == ({"SOLVER_V83_PAIR_RHS": "1"} if variant == "diagnostic_on" else {})
        assert all(row[field] == digest for field in ("solver_sha256_before", "solver_sha256_after", "frozen_solver_sha256"))
        assert all(row[field] == model["sha256"] for field in ("model_sha256", "model_sha256_after", "frozen_model_sha256"))
        assert row["hash_error"] is None
        marker, error = inspect_marker(row["stderr"], variant)
        assert row["pair_marker"] == marker and row["pair_marker_error"] == error
        assert row["configuration_matches"] is configuration_matches(row["report"], stage, variant, model, plan)
        if row["report"] is not None:
            assert row["report"] == benchmark.strict_json(row["stdout"])
        for field, value in quality_fields(row, model, digest, plan).items():
            assert row[field] == value, (index, field)
    computed = compare_lp.summarize(rows, expected["models"], expected["repeats"], plan["wall_timeout"], plan["time_limit"], variants(stage))
    computed.update(plan_sha256=PLAN_SHA, stage=stage, raw_sha256=sha(raw),
        valid_process_count=sum(valid_process(row) for row in rows), pair_marker_error_count=sum(row["pair_marker_error"] is not None for row in rows))
    assert computed == summary
    return manifest, summary, rows


def compatibility():
    plan = fixed_plan()
    pairs = []
    for stage in COMPAT:
        _, _, rows = archive(stage)
        for model in specification(stage, plan)["models"]:
            selected = {row["requested_variant"]: row for row in rows if row["model_index"] == model["model_index"]}
            a, b = (selected[variant] for variant in variants(stage))
            pairs.append({"stage": stage, "input": model["input"], **pair_result(a, b, plan)})
    assert len(pairs) == 17
    return {"passed": all(pair["category"] == "equal" for pair in pairs), "runs": 34, "pairs": pairs,
        "non_budget_equal": sum(pair["category"] == "equal" for pair in pairs),
        "budget_pairs": sum(pair["category"] == "budget_limited" for pair in pairs),
        "invalid_pairs": sum(pair["category"] == "invalid_process" for pair in pairs),
        "different_pairs": sum(pair["category"] == "different" for pair in pairs), "plan_sha256": PLAN_SHA}


def gate():
    _, development, _ = archive("development")
    _, probe, _ = archive("probe")
    result = base.gate_decision(development, probe)
    result["plan_sha256"] = PLAN_SHA
    result["valid_processes"] = all(item["valid_process_count"] == item["run_count"] for item in (development, probe))
    result["eligible_for_netlib"] = result["eligible_for_netlib"] and result["valid_processes"]

def run(stage, work):
    plan = fixed_plan()

    if stage not in COMPAT:

    save(DATA / f"v83-{stage}-manifest.json", manifest)
    raw = DATA / f"v83-{stage}-runs.jsonl.gz"
    rows = []
    with gzip.open(raw, "xt", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        for model, repeat, position, variant in compare_lp.schedule(models, expected["repeats"], variants(stage)):
            executable = Path(identity["candidate"] if variant.startswith("diagnostic_") else identity["reference"])
            expected_solver = identity["candidate_sha256"] if variant.startswith("diagnostic_") else identity["reference_sha256"]
            before = sha(executable)
            options = options_for(stage, variant, executable, plan)
            with solver_environment(variant == "diagnostic_on"):
                row = benchmark.run_one(options, Path(model["input"]), plan["seed"], len(rows))
            after, model_after = sha(executable), sha(model["input"])
            marker, marker_error = inspect_marker(row["stderr"], variant)
            row.update(model_index=model["model_index"], repetition=repeat, position_in_pair=position,
                requested_variant=variant, frozen_model_sha256=model["sha256"], model_sha256_after=model_after,
                solver_sha256_before=before, solver_sha256_after=after, frozen_solver_sha256=expected_solver,
                pair_environment={"SOLVER_V83_PAIR_RHS": "1"} if variant == "diagnostic_on" else {},
                pair_marker=marker, pair_marker_error=marker_error,
                configuration_matches=configuration_matches(row["report"], stage, variant, model, plan))
            row.update(quality_fields(row, model, expected_solver, plan))
            stream.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            stream.flush()
            rows.append(row)
            print(json.dumps({"stage": stage, "index": row["run_index"], "model": Path(model["input"]).stem,
                "variant": variant, "status": row["status"], "quality_pass": row["quality_pass"],
                "pair_marker_error": marker_error}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    summary = compare_lp.summarize(rows, models, expected["repeats"], plan["wall_timeout"], plan["time_limit"], variants(stage))
    summary.update(plan_sha256=PLAN_SHA, stage=stage, raw_sha256=sha(raw),
        valid_process_count=sum(valid_process(row) for row in rows), pair_marker_error_count=sum(row["pair_marker_error"] is not None for row in rows))
    save(DATA / f"v83-{stage}-summary.json", summary)
    for path, digest in identity["protected"].items():
        assert sha(path) == digest, path
    archive(stage)
    print(json.dumps({"stage": stage, "variants": summary["variants"], "valid_process_count": summary["valid_process_count"]}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)


def self_check():
    plan = fixed_plan()
    inherited = base.validation_self_check()
    math_evidence_self_check()
    assert plan["compatibility_excluded_report_fields"] == ["timings"]
    before = dict(os.environ)
    with solver_environment(True):
        assert {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if key.startswith("SOLVER_V")} == {"SOLVER_V83_PAIR_RHS": "1"}
        assert "OPENBLAS_CORETYPE" not in os.environ
        with solver_environment(False):
            assert not any(key.startswith("SOLVER_V") for key in os.environ)
        assert os.environ["SOLVER_V83_PAIR_RHS"] == "1"
    assert dict(os.environ) == before
    for stage in STAGES:
        for variant in variants(stage):
            value = options_for(stage, variant, PARENT, plan)
            assert value.time_limit == 5.0 and value.wall_timeout == 35 and value.threads == 1
            if variant == "highs":
                assert value.backend == "highs" and value.highs_solver == "choose"
            else:
                assert value.ipm_linear_solver == "normal_cholmod_aat" and value.ipm_linear_accuracy == "homogeneous_repair"
                assert value.ipm_objective_scaling == "off" and value.ipm_direction_retries == 0
    return {"passed": True, "solver_runs": 0, "inherited_count_and_budget_checks": inherited,
        "environment_cases": 4, "configuration_cases": 12, "marker_cases": marker_self_check()}


def marker_self_check():
    empty = {"schema": 1, "enabled": False, **dict.fromkeys(MARKER_COUNTS, 0)}
    assert valid_marker(empty, False)
    on = dict(empty, enabled=True)
    assert valid_marker(on, True)
    completed = {"schema": 1, "enabled": True, **dict.fromkeys(MARKER_COUNTS, 3)}
    assert valid_marker(completed, True)
    valid = [empty, on, completed]
    order = ("pairs_started", "normal_calls_started", "normal_calls_completed", "finish0_started",
        "finish0_completed", "finish1_started", "finish1_completed", "pairs_completed")
    for length in (1, 2, 3, 4, 6):
        row = dict(on)
        for key in order[:length]:
            row[key] = 1
        assert valid_marker(row, True)
        valid.append(row)
    mutations = []
    for key in ("schema", *MARKER_COUNTS):
        for wrong in (True, -1, 201, 0.5, None):
            row = dict(completed); row[key] = wrong; mutations.append(row)
    for key in ("enabled", *MARKER_COUNTS):
        row = dict(completed); row.pop(key); mutations.append(row)
    for key in MARKER_COUNTS:
        row = dict(on); row[key] = 1
        if not valid_marker(row, True): mutations.append(row)
    mutations += [dict(completed, enabled=1), dict(completed, unexpected=0),
        dict(completed, pairs_started=5), dict(completed, finish1_started=2),
        dict(completed, pairs_completed=2)]
    for row in mutations:
        assert not valid_marker(row, True)
    assert not valid_marker(dict(empty, pairs_started=1), False)
    assert not valid_marker(on, False) and not valid_marker(empty, True)
    for row in valid:
        variant = "diagnostic_on" if row["enabled"] else "diagnostic_off"
        parsed, error = inspect_marker(MARKER + json.dumps(row), variant)
        assert base.typed_equal(parsed, row) and error is None
    assert inspect_marker("", "frozen_v66") == (None, None)
    assert inspect_marker(MARKER + json.dumps(on), "highs")[1] == "unexpected_marker"
    for text in ("", MARKER + "{}", MARKER + '{"schema":1,"schema":1}',
                 MARKER + json.dumps(on) + "\n" + MARKER + json.dumps(on)):
        assert inspect_marker(text, "diagnostic_on")[1] is not None
    report = {"schema_version": 1, "backend": "ipm", "status": "numerical_error", "backend_version": "ipm-cpu-0.53.0",
        "options": {"ipm": {"linear_accuracy": "homogeneous_repair", "linear_solver": "normal_cholmod_aat"}},
        **dict.fromkeys(base.COUNT_FIELDS, 0), "ipm_factor_backend": None,
        "ipm_homogeneous_tau": None, "ipm_homogeneous_kappa": None,
        "timings": {"read_seconds": 0, "solve_seconds": 1, "verification_seconds": 0, "total_seconds": 1}}
    row = {"error": None, "classification": "incomplete", "returncode": 4, "status": "numerical_error", "report": report,
        "numerical_seconds": 1, "elapsed_wall_seconds": 2, "configuration_matches": True, "pair_marker_error": None}
    plan = {"time_limit": 5, "wall_timeout": 35, "compatibility_excluded_report_fields": ["timings"]}
    assert pair_result(row, row, plan)["category"] == "equal"
    changed = copy.deepcopy(row); changed["report"]["backend_version"] = "other"
    assert pair_result(row, changed, plan)["category"] == "different"
    budget = copy.deepcopy(row); budget["status"] = budget["report"]["status"] = "time_limit"
    assert pair_result(dict(row, pair_marker_error="marker_count"), budget, plan)["category"] == "invalid_process"
    for status, code, classification in (("numerical_error", 4, "incomplete"), ("time_limit", 4, "incomplete"),
        ("iteration_limit", 4, "incomplete"), ("verification_failed", 3, "verification_failed")):
        altered = copy.deepcopy(row)
        altered.update(status=status, returncode=code, classification=classification)
        altered["report"]["status"] = status
        assert valid_process(altered)
        altered["report"]["ipm_factorizations"] = True
        assert pair_result(altered, budget, plan)["category"] == "invalid_process"
    return {"valid_and_parse_cases": len(valid), "mutation_cases": len(mutations),
        "sidecar_cases": len(valid) + 6, "full_report_and_budget_cases": 7}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("stage", choices=("self-check", "compatibility", "gate", *STAGES))
    parser.add_argument("--work", type=Path, default=WORK)
    args = parser.parse_args()

        print(json.dumps(self_check(), ensure_ascii=False))

"""第63轮CHOLMOD矩形正规方程：先验旧路径兼容，再按固定开发/探针门槛扩集。"""
import argparse
import copy
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PLAN = DATA / "v66-plan.json"
PLAN_SHA = "5f134f630f8f969097c2b9c2b85912a89b4f20ef224043303367d43754d1dd06"
EXE = ROOT / ".tools/solver-ipm-v66.exe"
PARENT = ROOT / ".tools/solver-ipm-v57.exe"
COMPAT = ("compatibility-development", "compatibility-probe")
STAGES = (*COMPAT, "development", "probe", "netlib", "highs")
NEW_FIELDS = ()
ABSENT_FIELDS = ("ipm_extended_krylov_attempts", "ipm_extended_krylov_successes",
                 "ipm_homogeneous_scalar_checks", "ipm_homogeneous_scalar_rejections")
COUNT_FIELDS = ('ipm_iterations', 'ipm_factorizations', 'ipm_refinement_steps', 'ipm_weighted_krylov_steps', 'ipm_krylov_recycle_projections', 'ipm_krylov_recycle_acceptances', 'ipm_krylov_recycle_vectors', 'ipm_krylov_recycle_peak_dimension', 'ipm_regularization_searches', 'ipm_regularization_reductions', 'ipm_unshifted_factorizations', 'ipm_full_newton_preconditioner_solves', 'ipm_full_newton_products', 'ipm_bounded_newton_returns', 'ipm_bounded_newton_inexact_returns', 'ipm_homogeneous_constant_solves', 'ipm_homogeneous_constant_repairs', 'ipm_homogeneous_constant_repair_successes', 'ipm_homogeneous_direction_solves', 'ipm_homogeneous_scaled_products', 'ipm_homogeneous_scaled_refinement_steps', 'ipm_homogeneous_scaled_inexact_returns', 'ipm_direction_retries', 'ipm_direction_retry_successes', 'ipm_schur_residual_products', 'ipm_schur_refinement_steps', 'ipm_schur_refinement_acceptances', 'ipm_kkt_dimension', 'ipm_factor_nonzeros', 'ipm_structural_fallbacks', 'ipm_eliminated_singletons', 'ipm_regularized_pivots', 'ipm_backward_error_acceptances', 'ipm_inexact_acceptances', 'ipm_inexact_prefilter_rejections', 'ipm_eliminated_fixed_variables', 'ipm_presolved_singleton_rows', 'ipm_presolved_fixed_columns', 'ipm_central_correction_attempts', 'ipm_central_correction_acceptances')
OPTIONAL_COUNT_FIELDS = ("ipm_kkt_dimension", "ipm_factor_nonzeros", "ipm_eliminated_singletons")
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import benchmark
import compare_lp


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(path):
    return benchmark.strict_json(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def save(path, value):
    with Path(path).open("x", encoding="utf-8") as target:
        json.dump(value, target, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        target.write("\n")


def plan():
    assert sha(PLAN) == PLAN_SHA
    value = read(PLAN)
    assert sha(DATA / "ipm-v57-identity.json") == value["parent_identity_sha256"]
    assert sha(DATA / value["evidence_file"]) == value["evidence_sha256"]
    ancestor = value["implementation_ancestor"]
    assert sha(DATA / ancestor["identity_file"]) == ancestor["identity_sha256"]
    assert read(DATA / ancestor["identity_file"])["source_zip_sha256"] == ancestor["source_zip_sha256"]
    assert sha(DATA / value["starting_state"]["file"]) == value["starting_state"]["sha256"]
    assert (value["parent_version"], value["reference_version"], value["candidate_version"],
            value["reference_objective_scaling"], value["candidate_objective_scaling"]) == (57, 57, 66, "off", "off")
    assert value["candidate_backend_version"] == "ipm-cpu-0.53.0"
    assert value["new_report_fields"] == []
    assert value["compatibility_excluded_report_fields"] == ["timings", "backend_version"]
    assert (value["candidate_linear_solver"], value["reference_linear_solver"], value["compatibility_linear_solver"]) == ("normal_cholmod_aat", "normal_cholmod", "normal_cholmod")
    assert sha(DATA / value["baseline_check"]["file"]) == value["baseline_check"]["sha256"]
    identity = DATA / "ipm-v66-identity.json"
    if identity.exists():
        frozen = read(identity)
        assert frozen["runner_sha256"] == sha(__file__) and frozen["plan_sha256"] == PLAN_SHA
    return value


def environment():
    result = os.environ.copy()
    result.update({name: "1" for name in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS")})
    for key in tuple(result):
        if key.startswith("SOLVER_V"):
            result.pop(key)
    result.pop("OPENBLAS_CORETYPE", None)
    return result


def check_solver(version):
    executable = ROOT / f".tools/solver-ipm-v{version}.exe"
    assert sha(executable) == read(DATA / f"ipm-v{version}-identity.json")["solver_sha256"]
    return executable


def specification(stage, frozen):
    assert stage in STAGES
    value = copy.deepcopy(frozen["sets"]["netlib" if stage in ("netlib", "highs") else stage.removeprefix("compatibility-")])
    if stage in COMPAT:
        value["repeats"] = 1
    return value


def accuracy(stage, side, frozen):
    return frozen["compatibility_accuracy"] if stage in COMPAT else frozen[side + "_accuracy"]


def linear_solver(stage, side, frozen):
    return frozen["compatibility_linear_solver"] if stage in COMPAT else frozen[side + "_linear_solver"]


def command_for(stage, frozen, output):
    expected = specification(stage, frozen)
    command = [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "scripts/compare_lp.py"), "--solver", str(EXE),
               "--reference-solver", str(EXE if stage == "highs" else PARENT),
               "--models-file", expected["models_file"], "--repeats", str(expected["repeats"]),
               "--time-limit", str(frozen["time_limit"]), "--wall-timeout", str(frozen["wall_timeout"]),
               "--threads", str(frozen["threads"]), "--seed", str(frozen["seed"]),
               "--candidate-backend", "ipm", "--reference-backend", "highs" if stage == "highs" else "ipm",
               "--output-dir", str(output)]
    for prefix, side in (("--", "candidate"), ("--reference-", "reference")):
        if stage == "highs" and side == "reference":
            for name, value in frozen["highs_reference"].items():
                command += [prefix + "highs-" + name, value]
            continue
        command += [prefix + "iteration-limit", str(frozen["max_iterations"]),
                    prefix + "scaling-passes", str(frozen["scaling_passes"]),
                    prefix + "ipm-method", frozen["method"],
                    prefix + "ipm-linear-accuracy", accuracy(stage, side, frozen),
                    prefix + "ipm-linear-solver", linear_solver(stage, side, frozen),
                    prefix + "ipm-direction-retries", "0"]
        for key, value in frozen["shared_ipm"].items():
            command += [prefix + "ipm-" + key, value]
    command += ["--ipm-objective-scaling", frozen["candidate_objective_scaling"]]
    if stage != "highs":
        command += ["--reference-ipm-objective-scaling", frozen["reference_objective_scaling"]]
    return command


def archive(stage):
    frozen = plan()
    expected = specification(stage, frozen)
    manifest = read(DATA / f"v66-{stage}-manifest.json")
    summary = read(DATA / f"v66-{stage}-summary.json")
    rows = [benchmark.strict_json(line) for line in gzip.decompress((DATA / f"v66-{stage}-runs.jsonl.gz").read_bytes()).splitlines()]
    assert manifest["models"] == expected["models"] and manifest["models_file_sha256"] == expected["models_file_sha256"]
    assert len(rows) == len(expected["models"]) * expected["repeats"] * 2
    for key in ("time_limit", "wall_timeout", "threads", "seed"):
        assert manifest[key] == frozen[key]
    assert manifest["repeats"] == expected["repeats"]
    assert manifest["ipm_linear_accuracy"] == accuracy(stage, "candidate", frozen)
    assert manifest["ipm_linear_solver"] == linear_solver(stage, "candidate", frozen) and manifest["ipm_method"] == frozen["method"]
    if stage != "highs":
        assert manifest["reference_ipm_linear_accuracy"] == accuracy(stage, "reference", frozen)
        assert manifest["reference_ipm_linear_solver"] == linear_solver(stage, "reference", frozen)
        assert manifest["reference_ipm_method"] == frozen["method"]
    reference, candidate = manifest["reference_variant"], manifest["candidate_variant"]
    assert manifest["ipm_objective_scaling"] == frozen["candidate_objective_scaling"]
    assert manifest["reference_ipm_objective_scaling"] == (None if stage == "highs" else frozen["reference_objective_scaling"])
    for variant, version in ((reference, 66 if stage == "highs" else 57), (candidate, 66)):
        solver = manifest["solvers"][variant]
        assert Path(solver["path"]) == check_solver(version)
        assert solver["sha256"] == sha(solver["path"]) and solver["hash_error"] is None
    validate_rows(stage, frozen, manifest, rows)
    recomputed = compare_lp.summarize(rows, expected["models"], expected["repeats"],
        frozen["wall_timeout"], frozen["time_limit"], (reference, candidate))
    recomputed.update(configurations=manifest["variants"], output_dir=str(ROOT / f"results/round-ipm-v66-{stage}"))
    assert recomputed == summary
    return manifest, summary, rows


def typed_equal(a, b):
    if isinstance(a, dict) and isinstance(b, dict):
        return a.keys() == b.keys() and all(typed_equal(a[k], b[k]) for k in a)
    if isinstance(a, list) and isinstance(b, list):
        return len(a) == len(b) and all(typed_equal(x, y) for x, y in zip(a, b))
    if type(a) is bool or type(b) is bool:
        return type(a) is type(b) and a == b
    return a == b


def expected_options(stage, side, frozen):
    value = copy.deepcopy(frozen["expected_report_options"])
    if stage == "highs" and side == "reference":
        value.update(backend="highs", ipm=None, highs={"solver": "choose", "run_crossover": "on", "presolve": "choose"})
    else:
        value["ipm"]["linear_accuracy"] = accuracy(stage, side, frozen)
        value["ipm"]["linear_solver"] = linear_solver(stage, side, frozen)
    return value


def valid_counts(report, version, backend, mode):
    if not isinstance(report, dict) or any(field in report for field in ABSENT_FIELDS):
        return False
    if not all(field in report for field in COUNT_FIELDS):
        return False
    if backend != "ipm":
        return all(report[field] is None for field in COUNT_FIELDS)
    for field in COUNT_FIELDS:
        value = report[field]
        if value is None and field in OPTIONAL_COUNT_FIELDS:
            continue
        if type(value) is not int or not 0 <= value <= 9223372036854775807:
            return False
    weighted, refinements = (report[field] for field in ("ipm_weighted_krylov_steps", "ipm_refinement_steps"))
    repairs, successes, constants = (report["ipm_homogeneous_constant_" + suffix]
                                    for suffix in ("repairs", "repair_successes", "solves"))
    return successes <= repairs <= constants and weighted <= refinements and (mode != "homogeneous_repair" or weighted == 0)


def valid_factor_path(report, backend):
    if "ipm_factor_backend" not in report:
        return False
    actual = report["ipm_factor_backend"]
    if backend != "ipm":
        return actual is None
    requested = report.get("options", {}).get("ipm", {}).get("linear_solver")
    if requested not in ("normal_cholmod", "normal_cholmod_aat"):
        return False
    if actual is None:
        # 早退或结构回退构造中断均可能尚未写入实际后端标签。
        return True
    if actual == requested:
        return report.get("ipm_structural_fallbacks") == 0
    return actual == "factorhighs" and type(report.get("ipm_structural_fallbacks")) is int and report["ipm_structural_fallbacks"] > 0


def valid_process(row):
    report = row.get("report")
    if row.get("error") is not None or not isinstance(report, dict) or type(row.get("returncode")) is not int:
        return False
    if type(report.get("schema_version")) is not int or report["schema_version"] != 1:
        return False
    known = {"optimal": (0, "resolved"), "empty": (0, "resolved"), "infeasible": (0, "resolved"),
        "unbounded": (0, "resolved"), "verification_failed": (3, "verification_failed"),
        "iteration_limit": (4, "incomplete"), "time_limit": (4, "incomplete"), "numerical_error": (4, "incomplete")}
    status = report.get("status")
    if not isinstance(status, str) or status not in known or (row["returncode"], row.get("classification")) != known[status]:
        return False
    if benchmark.classify(row["returncode"], report) != row["classification"] or row.get("status") != status:
        return False
    timings = report.get("timings")
    if not isinstance(timings, dict) or not all(benchmark.finite_real(timings.get(name)) and timings[name] >= 0
        for name in ("read_seconds", "solve_seconds", "verification_seconds", "total_seconds")):
        return False
    backend = report.get("backend")
    options = report.get("options")
    if backend not in ("ipm", "highs") or not isinstance(options, dict):
        return False
    mode = None
    if backend == "ipm":
        ipm = options.get("ipm")
        if not isinstance(ipm, dict) or not isinstance(ipm.get("linear_accuracy"), str):
            return False
        mode = ipm["linear_accuracy"]
    if not valid_counts(report, None, backend, mode) or not valid_factor_path(report, backend):
        return False
    numerical, wall = row.get("numerical_seconds"), row.get("elapsed_wall_seconds")
    return benchmark.finite_real(numerical) and numerical >= 0 and benchmark.finite_real(wall) and wall > 0


def limited(row, frozen):
    return row.get("error") == "wall_timeout" or (row.get("report") or {}).get("status") == "time_limit" \
        or (benchmark.finite_real(row.get("elapsed_wall_seconds")) and row["elapsed_wall_seconds"] > frozen["wall_timeout"]) \
        or (benchmark.finite_real(row.get("numerical_seconds")) and row["numerical_seconds"] > frozen["time_limit"])


def pair_result(a, b, frozen):
    reports = [copy.deepcopy(row.get("report")) for row in (a, b)]
    for report in reports:
        if isinstance(report, dict):
            for field in frozen["compatibility_excluded_report_fields"]:
                report.pop(field, None)
    equal = typed_equal(*reports) and a.get("returncode") == b.get("returncode") and a.get("error") == b.get("error")
    valid = valid_process(a) and valid_process(b)
    budget = limited(a, frozen) or limited(b, frozen)
    category = "invalid_process" if not valid else "budget_limited" if budget else "equal" if equal else "different"
    return {"equal": equal, "valid_processes": valid, "budget_limited": budget, "category": category}


def validate_rows(stage, frozen, manifest, rows):
    expected = specification(stage, frozen)
    reference, candidate = manifest["reference_variant"], manifest["candidate_variant"]
    scheduled = list(compare_lp.schedule(expected["models"], expected["repeats"], (reference, candidate)))
    assert len(scheduled) == len(rows)
    for index, (row, (model, repeat, position, variant)) in enumerate(zip(rows, scheduled)):
        side = "reference" if variant == reference else "candidate"
        backend = "highs" if stage == "highs" and side == "reference" else "ipm"
        version = 57 if side == "reference" and stage != "highs" else 66
        solver = manifest["solvers"][variant]
        assert row["run_index"] == index and row["model_index"] == model["model_index"] and row["repetition"] == repeat
        assert row["position_in_pair"] == position and row["requested_variant"] == variant
        assert row["input"] == model["input"] and row["seed"] == frozen["seed"] and row["requested_backend"] == backend
        assert all(row[field] == model["sha256"] for field in ("model_sha256", "model_sha256_after", "frozen_model_sha256"))
        assert all(row[field] == solver["sha256"] for field in ("solver_sha256_before", "solver_sha256_after", "frozen_solver_sha256"))
        assert row["hash_error"] is None
        # 墙钟杀进程也保留原始记录，但不能通过兼容合同或继续扩集。
        assert valid_process(row), "非法进程/状态记录：" + str(index)
